summary: This note is a git submodule configuration file (.gitmodules) from a robotics project. It lists nine submodules, each mapped to a local path under src/lib/ and a GitHub repository URL. The repositories include motor controller, local and coverage planners, NTRIP GNSS client, ROS message packages, GPS driver, positioning, monitoring and remote-control components, mostly from the ClemensElflein GitHub account.
one_line: A .gitmodules file listing nine ROS robotics library submodules under src/lib with their GitHub source URLs.
key_facts: The note is a .gitmodules file in a robotics project with the domain listed as robotics.
The file defines nine submodules, each with a path under src/lib/.
The submodule src/lib/ntrip_client points to https://github.com/LORD-MicroStrain/ntrip_client.git, the only one from the LORD-MicroStrain account.
The submodule src/lib/xbot_monitoring points to https://github.com/ClemensElflein/xbot_monitoring without a .git suffix.
The submodule src/lib/xbot_remote points to https://github.com/ClemensElflein/xbot_remote without a .git suffix.
Each submodule entry uses a path line and a url line in git config format.
